svg.title: vLLM packed batch and KV cache block table
svg.desc: Three requests packed into one flat input with no per-request padding: A decodes one token at position 16, B prefills two tokens, C prefills three tokens from position 14. Two padding tokens at the end come from a CUDA graph size. query_start_loc marks where each request starts in the input (0, 1, 3, 6), and seq_lens gives each request length including its cached tokens (17, 2, 17). Each token finds its KV slot through its request block table: position // 16 picks the block and position % 16 the offset. C15 and C16 are adjacent in the input but land in blocks 9 and 4. Padding tokens get slot -1.

g.text: C15 and C16 sit side by side in the input but land in different KV blocks
